acquisition method: The scan sequence of the mass spectrometer was based on the original TopTen™ method; using multi-notch MS3 parameters
cleavage agent: digested on-bead using filter-aided sample preparation with sequencing grade modified porcine trypsin
collision energy: The HCD fragmentation energy (N)CE/stepped NCE was set to 28; normalized collision energy of 30%; normalized collision energy of 35.0; normalized collision energy of 65.0
enrichment method: biotinylated proteins were enriched using Pierce™ streptavidin agarose beads
fractionation method: separated into 46 fractions on a 100 × 1.0 mm Acquity BEH C18 column
The labeled peptide multiplex was separated into 46 fractions on a 100 × 1.0 mm Acquity BEH C18 column
fragmentation method: The HCD fragmentation energy (N)CE/stepped NCE was set to 28; Following CID activation
instrument: Thermo Scientific Q Exactive HF Orbitrap; Orbitrap Eclipse Tribrid

Nano-liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry (Nano-LC/MS/MS) was performed on a Thermo Scientific Q Exactive HF Orbitrap mass spectrometer; mass spectrometric analysis on an Orbitrap Eclipse Tribrid mass spectrometer
ionization type: Eluted peptides were ionized by electrospray (2.4 kV)
labeling: Tryptic peptides were labeled using tandem mass tag isobaric labeling reagents
mass analyzer: MS/MS data were acquired using the ion trap analyzer
precursor tolerance: a parent ion tolerance of 10.0 ppm; a parent ion tolerance of 2.5 ppm; a parent ion tolerance of 3 ppm
fragment tolerance: a fragment ion mass tolerance of 0.020 Da; a fragment ion tolerance of 0.5 Da
ptm: fixed Carbamidomethyl of cysteine; variable Met-loss of methionine; variable met-loss+Acetyl of methionine; variable oxidation of methionine; variable acetyl of the N-terminus

Carbamidomethyl of cysteine was specified in Sequest as a fixed modification. Met-loss of methionine, met-loss+Acetyl of methionine, oxidation of methionine and acetyl of the N-terminus were specified in Sequest as variable modifications.
